correctness.rationale: Starting from Merca’s exact coefficient formula, for each odd prime p and e≥0 independently verified σ(p^e)−λ(p^e)≡4[ p≡3,5 mod8 ]ceil(e/2) mod8. Multiplicativity modulo8 yields a sum over distinguished primes; λ(q^e) is odd iff e even, forcing zero/one/≥two odd exponents into stated square/one-prime/zero parity cases. The derived dyadic recurrence toggles parity precisely on odd squares. Independent exact arithmetic checked all n≤50000 plus sample prime-power congruences, including n=1,2,4. The asymptotic removes square, higher p^{4j+1} j≥1 and p|r terms by O(sqrt X); main term ∑_{t≥0,r odd} π_-(X/(2^t r²)) with π_-(y)~y/(2logy). Absolute convergence of weights and O(X^{5/6}) large weights yield coefficient (1/2)·2·π²/8=π²/8; the finite ratio need not approximate its limit quickly.
